items.title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026: Spotify Expands Audiobooks to 180 Markets
items.excerpt: Spotify is taking its audiobook service from 22 markets to more than 180. It presents AI narration as a way to bring titles into local languages that are too small to pay for a human narrator, and self-published authors can already produce AI-narrated audiobooks through its ElevenLabs partnership.
